entries.reason: The full question asks whether to save changes, rather than commanding a save or claiming success. The explicit subject is idiomatic and fits the dirty-document replacement guard.
entries.linguistic_details: Vil du + a-infinitive lagra is sound Nynorsk; endringane is definite plural. No reason to shorten the question solely to mimic English word count.
entries.semantic_details: The title does not alter Save / Discard / Keep-editing behavior and does not promise the replacement has happened.

entries.source: Your current image has unsaved changes.
entries.original_candidate_display_text: Biletet du arbeider med, har endringar som ikkje er lagra.
entries.reason: The complete warning identifies the image currently being worked on and retains the explicit unsaved condition. It neither describes an older recovery copy nor asserts image loss.
entries.linguistic_details: The omitted-som relative clause du arbeider med identifies biletet. Its closing comma before har is correct; deleting that comma would not be an improvement. Biletet and ikkje er lagra are appropriate forms.
entries.semantic_details: The consumer has applied pending edits and tested document.dirty, matching the present-tense description.
entries.approved_display_text: Biletet du arbeider med, har endringar som ikkje er lagra.
entries.approved_xml_text: "Biletet du arbeider med, har endringar som ikkje er lagra."

entries.source: The export was created. Use Save or Save as to save the current image before continuing.
entries.original_candidate_display_text: Eksporten er oppretta. Bruk «Lagra» eller «Lagra som…» til å lagra biletet du arbeider med, før du held fram.
entries.reason: Replace the abstract subject Eksporten with Eksportfila so the first sentence unmistakably describes the output artifact. The original is understandable, but is less explicit about what has been created. This is a clarity revision, not a claim that oppretta is ungrammatical.
entries.linguistic_details: Oppretta is an allowed Nynorsk participle. The rest of the complete sentence is retained: the relative-clause closing comma before før distinguishes the working-image description from the before-continuing condition. Quoted Lagra and Lagra som… exactly follow untouched local labels.
entries.semantic_details: A file has just been written successfully, but exporting did not satisfy afterSave. The replacement says neither export failure nor that the current document is saved. The required subsequent Save or Save as remains explicit.
entries.confidence: medium-high for the replacement as bounded linguistic/static review
entries.approved_display_text: Eksportfila er oppretta. Bruk «Lagra» eller «Lagra som…» til å lagra biletet du arbeider med, før du held fram.
entries.approved_xml_text: "Eksportfila er oppretta. Bruk «Lagra» eller «Lagra som…» til å lagra biletet du arbeider med, før du held fram."

entries.reason: Kunne ikkje lagra biletet is a natural failure statement preserving the source negation and object. It does not assert deletion or loss of the original.
entries.linguistic_details: No trailing full stop is included: ioFailed itself adds a full stop and space before the exception or fallback. No placeholder is introduced.
entries.semantic_details: The same write failure path can serve Save, Export or Share, so it properly remains a generic image-write/save failure rather than claiming a particular Save destination was lost.

entries.reason: The filename-first passive is a completed-output status, not an imperative. Its grammatical subject is the exact filename argument, not all document edits.
entries.linguistic_details: Exactly one indexed %1$s string placeholder remains. The form lagra does not introduce filename-dependent gender or number inflection. Reordering the indexed argument is safe at the resource-text level.
entries.semantic_details: The toast follows every successful write, including export/share. Naming the output file does not claim document.markSaved occurred. The source itself uses Saved for all writes; this translation does not broaden that claim.

entries.source: Export an icon, Base64 text or ASCII art. Exporting keeps the current image and its Save destination unchanged.
entries.original_candidate_display_text: Eksporter eit ikon, Base64-tekst eller ASCII-kunst. Eksportering endrar korkje biletet du arbeider med, eller lagringsmålet for «Lagra».
entries.reason: Replace lagringsmålet for «Lagra» with the explicit clause kva fil «Lagra» lagrar til. The compound is morphologically plausible and is not declared invalid Nynorsk; the revision removes an unnecessary reader inference about goal, folder, or full file target in this high-risk explanation.
entries.linguistic_details: The complete value retains the three outputs and korkje … eller over both unchanged items. The comma after du arbeider med closes the embedded relative clause, rather than being an English-style list comma. Kva fil … is an indirect-question clause, not a new question to the user.
entries.semantic_details: The replacement refers to which file Save writes to, not to that file remaining byte-for-byte unchanged, and not merely to its containing folder. It does not assert a destination must already exist; export leaves the target selection unchanged, including when not yet set.
entries.confidence: medium-high for the replacement as bounded linguistic/static review; the full wording is a reviewer judgment, not an official prescribed software term
entries.approved_display_text: Eksporter eit ikon, Base64-tekst eller ASCII-kunst. Eksportering endrar korkje biletet du arbeider med, eller kva fil «Lagra» lagrar til.

entries.source: Choose an image format and its compression settings. Save will reuse this file name, location, format and settings.
entries.original_candidate_display_text: Vel eit biletformat og innstillingane for komprimering. «Lagra» vil bruka dette filnamnet, denne plasseringa, formatet og innstillingane om att.
entries.reason: The full two-sentence instruction is idiomatic and retains all four reused choices: filename, location, format and settings. It distinguishes choosing format/compression now from later reuse by Save.
entries.linguistic_details: Vel is an imperative. Bruka and om att form a clear reuse expression. Plasseringa, in a coordinated list with filnamnet, unambiguously concerns storage location here rather than image position. The feminine agreement denne plasseringa is sound.
entries.semantic_details: requestSave reuses the remembered URI and options; the text does not reassign this behavior to Export or Share, require lossy compression, or promise a successful write.

entries.source: Save a copy to your chosen location, then choose an app to share it. Your current Save destination stays unchanged.
entries.original_candidate_display_text: Lagra ein kopi på staden du vel, og vel deretter ein app til å dela kopien. Lagringsmålet for «Lagra» er uendra.
entries.reason: Replace the final sentence with Dette endrar ikkje kva fil «Lagra» lagrar til. This makes the unchanged normal-Save file target explicit and aligns terminology with the revised export explanation. The copy-location and sharing-app instruction is retained.
entries.linguistic_details: Lagra ein kopi … og vel deretter … preserves an ordered instruction. Ein app til å dela kopien is an acceptable purpose construction. The comma after du vel closes the embedded relative clause. The new final sentence uses an indirect-question object, not a question to the user.
entries.semantic_details: Share is called with share=true and export=true: the copy is written to the chosen location before launching the app chooser; normal savedTarget/dirty state is not changed. The text does not say the copy has already been shared, or equate the selected sharing app with the Save destination.
entries.confidence: medium-high for the replacement as bounded linguistic/static review
